level_id_bank.method: Fib, THREE forward ladders (0 = swing LOW -> 1 = swing HIGH). A = deep base 28.60->472.50 (carried from 260710), C = the 2026 crash leg 313.80->365.40 (NEW), D = a 2022->2024 mid leg 511.50->773.90 (NEW). All three verified rung-by-rung against the chart labels: max |calc-drawn| 0.05 / 0.09 / 0.12. Box edges measured from a 17-point least-squares pixel->price fit (residual <=0.20). The 260710 recovery ladder B (418.65->529.45) is NOT on these charts -- the operator re-anchored it onto the crash low, so its rungs are dropped per the RE-ANCHOR STALE FIBS habit rather than kept as a fourth vote.
